title: An age measurement

doesNotKnow: The marked interval runs from 98 to 102 million years for the stated ±2 example. Real radiometric dates require method-specific uncertainty and geological interpretation; this is an arithmetic illustration.

misconception: The first apparent interpretation is the only possible one.
objective: A modeled measurement reports 100 ± 2 million years. Which interval represents that reported uncertainty?
